meta.name: visual-qa
meta.description: MUST USE after building/changing any UI or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right. Rigorous visual QA across web/page and terminal UIs. Prefer browser:control-in-app-browser for unauthenticated browser/page QA in Codex, then Playwright/agent-browser/dev-browser. Captures screenshot/TUI evidence with bundled diff scripts, runs design-system/functional and visual-fidelity/CJK reviewer passes, then synthesizes a good/bad verdict. Triggers: visual QA, screenshot/pixel diff, UI looks wrong, reference fidelity, design system check, responsive check, CJK text clipping, TUI alignment, box-drawing drift.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动检查UI页面和终端界面的视觉正确性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要自动化验证UI的像素级正确性
copy.tagline_en: Automatically verify visual correctness of UI pages and terminal interfaces
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need automated pixel-level UI verification

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会在你构建或修改任何用户界面后，自动进行严格的视觉质量检查。它会截取屏幕截图，与参考图或预期效果进行像素级对比，并运行两个独立的审查流程，最终给出“通过”或“需修改”的结论。
howto.when: 当你构建或修改了任何网页界面或终端界面，并声称完成时触发。也适用于你怀疑界面有回归问题、CJK 文字显示异常，或需要验证界面与设计稿一致时。

say.text: 帮我检查这个新做的登录页面，看看和设计稿是否一致。
这个终端表格的边框好像对不齐，帮我检查一下。
say.note: Claude 会捕获终端界面，检查边框对齐和文字溢出等问题。

say.text: 检查一下这个响应式布局在移动端是否正常。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude automatically performs rigorous visual QA on any UI you build or modify. It captures screenshots, compares them pixel-by-pixel with references or expected results, runs two independent review passes, and outputs a pass/revise verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you build or modify any web or terminal UI and claim it's done. Also when you suspect regressions, CJK text issues, or need to verify UI against a design mock.

say_en.text: Check this new login page against the design mock.
The terminal table borders look misaligned, please check.
Verify this responsive layout on mobile viewport.
